title: Insights from GitHub Community on the Matter Standard: Developer Perspectives and Challenges
subcategory: software engineering: LDA on GitHub issues
task: Identifying developer challenges with the Matter IoT standard
problem: Little is known about the practical problems developers face when implementing Matter.
architecture: Issues (title + body) are cleaned (code blocks, logs removed) and modelled with Gensim LDA tuned by grid search over number of topics (5-95), passes and iterations; topics are grouped into categories and analysed qualitatively with resolution-time statistics.

datasets.name: connectedhomeip
datasets.details: 13,008 issues from the official Project CHIP repository, 2020 - August 2025

key_results: Four areas of concern: Testing, Interoperability, Development, Platform & Network; Testing covers 5,545 issues (42.63%).
725 issues (5.57%) contain security- or privacy-related keywords, 166 of them still open.
strengths: Large real-world corpus with grid-searched LDA hyper-parameters and qualitative validation.

limitations.text: Repository data do not show how reports feed into standardisation decisions and only partly reflect end-user experience.

notes: Workshop paper from the author-curated corpus; the code link is the analysed repository.
